rows.label: HIAS: total operating expenses less donated services, fiscal year to 30 September 2025

source.title: HIAS, Inc. and Related Entities, Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 30 September 2025 (GRF CPAs & Advisors)

rows.explainer: Total operating expenses $153,436,885 less the contributed nonfinancial assets booked as US professional fees, $18,746,450 (legal services $18,735,450 and a data security workshop $11,000, note 9) = $134,690,435. Read by all three of charityevals' HIAS models, so management and fundraising are spread over cash spending, not over law firms' billing value.

source.title: HIAS, Inc. and Related Entities, Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 30 September 2025 (GRF CPAs & Advisors)

rows.explainer: Programme services $128,531,300 (US operations $80,432,761, international operations $48,098,539) less the $18,746,450 of donated services, all booked in US operations (note 9) = $109,784,850.

rows.label: HIAS: donated legal and professional services booked in US operations, fiscal 2025

source.title: HIAS, Inc. and Related Entities, Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 30 September 2025 (GRF CPAs & Advisors)

rows.explainer: Pro bono lawyers' time ($18,735,450) and a donated workshop ($11,000), recorded as contributions and as US professional fees at their fair value. Read by the US services model, which leaves it out of HIAS's cost and puts the lawyers' time in the legal branch's credit share.

rows.label: HIAS: US advocacy, community engagement and litigation cost booked in US operations, fiscal 2025 (US$)
rows.explainer: The accounts report US operations as one line; the Form 990 describes advocacy, community engagement (Refugee Shabbat, action alerts, vigils, regional outreach in New York and Los Angeles) and HIAS's role as plaintiff in Pacito v. Trump and Global Health Council v. Trump within it (Schedule O; annual report pp. 12-15). Lobbying itself was only $12,240 (Schedule C), so the cost is mostly staff: a policy and advocacy team, community engagement staff and campaign costs of about $3 million, $1.5 million to $6 million, of the line's $61.7 million in cash. Taken out of the US services model's cost and put in the advocacy model's, so each counts it once.
